fullPassage:
Eiffel Tower Effect

Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?" When the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron tower was very different from all the other architecture in Paris, which was mainly made of stone. Many local people disliked the tower and complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris. Nevertheless, as the locals became familiar with the tower due to exposure, they became more and more fond of it, referring to it as the Tower of Love. This effect, also called the "Mere Exposure Effect," is found with people, too. Psychologist Robert Zajonc and his colleagues showed university students pictures of several faces. Some pictures were shown 25 times while others were shown only once or twice. Then, the students were shown a picture and asked to express how much they liked that person. The students liked the people they had seen more often better than those they had seen less frequently. This shows that the more we are exposed to something, the more favorably we view it.

questions.ans: they became more and more fond of it

questions.passage: Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?" When the Eiffel Tower was first built, many local people disliked the tower. Nevertheless, as the locals became familiar with the tower due to exposure, they became more and more fond of it. This effect, also called the "Mere Exposure Effect," is found with people, too. The students liked the people they had seen more often better than those they had seen less frequently. This shows that the more we are exposed to something, the more favorably we view it.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 반복적 노출이 대상에 대한 호감에 미치는 영향

det.korean: 글 전체가 반복적 노출이 호감을 높인다는 '단순 노출 효과'를 설명.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 반복 노출 → 호감: Mere Exposure Effect의 핵심
❌ ① 건설 역사: 예시일 뿐 주제 아님
❌ ② 건축 재료: iron vs stone은 배경
❌ ④ 사진 선택: 실험 방법일 뿐 주제 아님
det.tip: 주제문: 'the more we are exposed to something, the more favorably we view it.'

questions.passage: Psychologist Robert Zajonc and his colleagues showed university students pictures of several faces. Some pictures were shown 25 times while others were shown only once or twice. Then, the students were shown a picture and asked to ____ how much they liked that person.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.

"학생들은 그 사람을 얼마나 좋아하는지 표현하도록 요청받았다."

→ The students were asked to __________ how much they liked that person.

(한 단어를 쓰시오) (조건: 1단어 사용) (1단어)

det.korean: 원문: 'asked to express how much they liked' — 표현하다.
det.analysis: ✅ express: ask + to부정사(수동태). express = 표현하다
det.tip: express: 표현하다. express how much = 얼마나 ~한지 표현하다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

"우리가 무언가에 더 많이 노출될수록, 우리는 그것을 더 호의적으로 바라본다."

→ The more we are exposed to something, __________ we view it.

(the, more, favorably를 사용하여 쓰시오) (3단어)

det.korean: 원문: 'the more favorably we view it' — the 비교급 구문.
det.analysis: ✅ the more favorably: the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~ 구문. 부사 favorably의 비교급.
det.tip: the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~: ~할수록 더 ~하다. the more favorably = 더 호의적으로.
